title: The power of DNA-encoded chemical libraries in the battle against drug-resistant bacteria
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14001-14029
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00016E, Review Article
Open Access

Riyad E. Sibai, Zainab E. M. Farahat, Hasnaa H. Qasem, Haitham Hassan
Drug-resistant bacteria are a rising menace, rendering many antibiotics powerless. This review explores the role of DNA-encoded chemical libraries as a game-changer, uncovering new antibacterial agents and sparking hope in the battle against antimicrobial resistance.
